title: PersonaSeedIntent
description: Normalized user intent for searching persona seed providers.

roleHint.description: OpenPersona role hint (companion, mentor, assistant, …). Not used as a hard MatrAIx filter.

domain.description: Domain / occupation keywords to match against seed capabilities.

locale.description: Language / locale codes or names (e.g. en, zh, Spanish).

exclude.description: Keywords or constraint flags to avoid.

provider.description: Provider id. Default: matraix-persona-1m when only one is installed.

query.description: Free-text user request; agent may leave structured fields empty and rely on rerank.
